summary: The final probe closed the distance between the defect's mechanism and the read pattern it undermines, and the receipt confirmed it in every mixed trial: a competing leader appeared 21-31ms after the partition, committed its entry, and at least one confirmation was obtained while that leader's commit index (7) was already above the cut-off leader's applied index (5), with the first such moment at 22-32ms. Both declared comparisons hold and are complete — twelve of twelve mixed trials show the coincidence, and both uniform controls show no competing leader, no far-side commit and no coincidence — so what the run establishes is not merely that an unsound confirmation can coexist with a newer leader but that it can accompany committed state the confirming node has never applied, which is precisely the condition the documented read pattern asks VerifyLeader to exclude. I appended that interpretation, marked the question explained, and revised the parent VerifyLeader account one final time so its consequence is stated at the strength the evidence carries rather than the weaker version recorded before the mixed-timer work: the mechanism is unchanged (the tally counts acknowledgements from every registered replication peer, nonvoters included, while the quorum counts voters only), the condition is an inequality between configured per-node values that ValidateConfig accepts because it validates each node on its own, and the scope limits stay explicit — a nonvoter must be present, the nodes must not share timers, no application read is served so the witness is the stale-read precondition rather than a delivered wrong value, and one timer pair in in-memory clusters characterises that configuration rather than estimating a deployment's exposure. With that, every registered question is answered: three execution-grounded findings — the startup replay that blocks NewRaft, the nonvoter acknowledgement that satisfies VerifyLeader's voter quorum and can accompany committed state the confirming leader lacks, and the membership change that installs a voter immediately and can strand a single-voter cluster — plus the refuted suspicions and excluded causes recorded with their evidence.
